rows.text: Necromancer summons an Imp to fight for him until being slayed. It takes ${cfg.args.shareDMG}% of DMG Taken for its master. Its stats grow as Necromancer levels up
Necromancer summons a Felfiend with [Lifesteal] to fight for him until being slayed. It takes ${cfg.args.shareDMG}% of DMG Taken for its master. Its stats grow as Necromancer levels up

Necromancer summons an Overfiend with [Lifesteal] and [Immune to Control] to fight for him until being slayed. It takes ${cfg.args.shareDMG}% of DMG Taken for its master. Its stats grow as Necromancer levels up

King calls the royal legion, summoning ${cfg.args.Number} Royal Guards and ${cfg.args.Number1} Royal Archers. Royal legion exists for ${cfg.args.duration/1000} seconds. Royal legion's stats grow as King levels up.

King calls the royal legion, summoning ${cfg.args.Number} Royal Guards and ${cfg.args.Number1} Royal Archers. Royal legion exists for ${cfg.args.duration/1000} seconds, and they recover ${cfg.args.healRate}% HP per sec when out of combat. Royal legion's stats grow as King levels up.

King calls the royal legion, summoning ${cfg.args.Number} Royal Guards and ${cfg.args.Number1} Royal Archers. Royal legion exists for ${cfg.args.duration/1000} seconds, and they recover ${cfg.args.healRate}% HP per sec when out of combat. King gains ${cfg.args.defence}% DMG Reduction for each soldier on the field. Royal legion's stats grow as King levels up.
